packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates. Riskier managers opt out below.
Actions bumps touch the release workflow, where a bad version fails quietly instead of turning CI red. Digests stay pinned by helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver; merge by hand.
Base-image digest refreshes are content-identical rebuilds; CI is enough.

description: The chart ships this repo's own image, with image.tag deliberately left empty so it falls back to the chart appVersion that release-please and CI set per release.

docker:pinDigests writes the digest into that empty tag, and deployment.yaml renders `{{ repository }}:{{ tag | default appVersion }}`, so the image comes out as the invalid `repo:@sha256:...`. There are no chart unit tests here to catch it, so it would surface as an ImagePullBackOff.
Digests never belong in this values file; plain version updates still apply, should the chart ever point at an image it does not build.

packageRules.description: k8s.io/* and controller-runtime versions are dictated by the cert-manager release (broke the build when bumped past it, see v0.3.0). They move via go mod tidy when cert-manager itself is bumped.
